status: approved and published — implementation not started
accepted_test_scope: Production portal HTTP boundary with local identity provider and disposable PostgreSQL, browser acceptance against the same built service, existing helper tests for arithmetic edge cases.
shared_acceptance: Every slice lands with functioning real handler-to-UI behavior, its own security/correctness checks, responsive browser acceptance and preservation of unchanged capabilities. Ticket 12 is cross-slice cutover and composition, not deferred feature testing.
prefactor_decision: No stand-alone horizontal refactor ticket is justified. Any narrow presentation extraction or fixture launcher needed for the first complete account slice is included in 01. Existing surfaces remain working until replaced.

tickets.title: Read Relay Account capacity in Workspace A
tickets.delivers: A working account overview with the selected shell, real allowance and capacity, restricted-account states, folded phone navigation and a reusable browser fixture around the built service.
acceptance: Serve the selected Workspace A account view using real authenticated handler data, embedded assets and the existing template stack; introduce shared layout/tokens without breaking unmigrated portal surfaces.

Lead with remaining allowance, Recorded Relay Usage against effective allowance, the authoritative UTC Weekly Quota Window/reset, Relay Sessions and Login Grants. Put the week in the allowance area on phones.

Preserve exact recorded totals for zero allowance and overruns; remaining allowance and available slots are nonnegative without hiding above-limit observations. Known zero and independently unavailable capacity samples remain different.

Render Pending, Suspended, Denied, first-run and Recovery Review Hold states honestly; an Active label or capacity count never claims Device Network membership or connectivity. First registration may retain current-week consumption.
Provide read-only state refresh and an accessible accounting explanation with truthful confirmation-lag language; omit unsupported sampled timestamps.

Apply the A type, color, spacing and focus rules to this view, keep real links to currently available areas, and fold navigation at tablet/phone widths. Do not expose unfinished destinations or remove old controls before their replacements land.

Reuse the existing production HTTP handler, local identity-provider and disposable PostgreSQL fixtures. Add only the minimal launcher needed to exercise that same built application in a browser, without a public test-login endpoint or UI-only account store.

Verify the delivered account cases through HTTP and the built browser view at 1440, 768 and 390 pixels, including keyboard/menu behavior, 320px reflow, enlarged text and no-script account facts. Preserve the accepted relay/accounting/authorization invariants.
tickets.blocking_rationale: No new prefactor is needed before a complete read-only account slice; the existing embedded templates and HTTP integration seam are reusable.

tickets.title: Read recent Recorded Relay Usage on every screen size
tickets.delivers: The latest four weeks by default, all thirteen retained weeks on demand, a visible current week on phones and accessible exact totals.
acceptance: Render the latest four available weekly observations in chronological order by default and allow selection of all retained thirteen without changing the underlying data or retention.
Identify the current week as incomplete, with the A green/neutral chart treatment, zero baseline and readable binary-unit scale. Do not invent growth deltas or a completed-week comparison.
Make the current week available on a phone without page-wide horizontal scrolling or hover, including when the full range is selected.
Provide an accessible table with complete week dates and exact corresponding totals; meaningful history remains available without scripting.
Keep zero and missing observations distinct, preserve absolute history after allowance changes, and cover year rollover and large recorded values.
Extend existing HTTP/profile-history and high-value formatting/geometry tests, plus responsive browser interaction checks against the built application. Do not assert every SVG coordinate.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the new account overview, A presentation and shared built-service browser fixture from 01.

tickets.title: Connect Clipp and sign in from a compact entry page
tickets.delivers: A first-screen Connect Clipp action, reliable discovery URL copying and setup help, plus the compact signed-out Google sign-in page.
acceptance: Connect Clipp from the account header reaches the actual canonical Relay Discovery Endpoint and current client setup instructions; a compact connection panel sits near history on desktop.
Announce copy success only after clipboard success. A denied or unavailable Clipboard API leaves a readable selectable URL and a manual-copy path.

Keep instructions reachable by keyboard and without scripting, and explain the distinction between a Portal Session and each app authorization. Never expose credentials or claim connection success from copying.

Serve the compact signed-out Google sign-in view with the relay purpose, approval requirement and setup help for already approved visitors. Wire sign-in to the existing real continuation rather than the prototype simulation.
Keep setup usable for restricted accounts while accurately explaining that approval or restoration is still required; an ordinary browser discovery error is not treated as failed setup.

Check HTTP sign-in/continuation compatibility and browser entry, setup disclosure, focus, clipboard success/refusal and mobile reachability at the accepted widths. Preserve CSP and no-script navigation.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Hooks into the first-screen account action and A entry presentation introduced by 01.

tickets.title: Manage Portal Sessions and Account-wide Revocation
tickets.delivers: A separate Access & security view with working portal-only logout and a reviewed Sign out everywhere operation.
acceptance: Add a protected navigable Access & security view in the A shell. Preserve any still-unmigrated deletion control or link until its dedicated slice replaces it.
Portal-only logout ends the current Portal Session while keeping Clipp Login Grants and relay access intact, as established by the existing service contract.

Sign out everywhere names the account and consequences before confirmation, then performs the existing Account-wide Revocation. Its result honors logical invalidation before success and does not claim physical socket closure has already finished.
Use the established mutation endpoint and security checks, with working read-only navigation and a no-script confirmation path that cannot bypass the review.
Place identity, grant counts and explanation correctly; do not invent a per-device registry or unsupported individual-grant management.

Extend the existing owner-security HTTP scenarios and browser checks for confirmation, focus restoration, logout destination, no-script operation and narrow-screen layout. Test refusals and ambiguous results, not just the successful button click.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the working shell/navigation and same authenticated browser fixture from 01.

tickets.title: Delete a Relay Account with truthful lifecycle results
tickets.delivers: Deliberate account deletion from Access & security, including recent-authentication guidance, pending/completed views and accurate re-registration copy.
acceptance: Integrate the A deletion control into Access & security with an explicit account-naming confirmation and an equivalent safe no-script path.

Preserve recent Google authentication, Origin/CSRF, account generation and existing journal/operation safeguards; guide the owner through required reauthentication without silently replaying deletion.
Honor the existing deletion contract through real handlers: pending is not complete, status observation is read-only, and closing the browser does not cancel an admitted operation.
Use task-sized pending/completed/error surfaces with their correct HTTP semantics and safe destinations. Preserve uncertainty rather than manufacturing success.
Explain that re-registration creates a new Pending Relay Account and may import Retained Quota Usage for the current window; do not promise a fresh allowance or restore the deleted account state.

Reuse deletion/journal doubles, disposable database integration and existing lifecycle scenarios, then verify browser confirmation, status links, keyboard focus and responsive rendering. Do not require live OCI resources or a production deletion.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Installs the deletion interaction into the separate Access & security view delivered by 04.

tickets.title: Find and open Relay Account reviews
tickets.delivers: An administrator account list with global search/status filtering, bounded pages, reliable plan names, desktop selection and a focused phone review view.
acceptance: Enforce current Administrator Identity authority for the view and show administration navigation only when authorized. Keep the nonsecret applied allowlist revision available.
Default to All accounts, show a clearly scoped service-wide pending-review finding, and provide Needs review and Suspended filters while keeping all canonical statuses reachable.

Apply bounded literal case-insensitive email matching and status selection before pagination over the full eligible dataset. Escape output and parameterize input; punctuation is literal, not a wildcard.

Keep a deterministic traversal, validated page limits and scopes, correctly labelled filtered/service-wide counts, empty-result feedback and clear-filter recovery. Reset incompatible cursors when the scope changes.
Resolve assigned Quota Plan names and saved effective quota information independently of the current library page, including archived/off-page plans.

On desktop, place the selected account beside the list. On phones, keep Review visible and make explicit selection a primary detail view with Back retaining validated list context; initial automatic desktop selection does not hide the mobile list.
Preserve working existing action forms and mutations in the detail view until their action-specific replacements land. No capability is removed by this list/navigation slice.

Use the existing read-view/HTTP boundary and built-service browser fixture. Seed enough accounts/plans to cross pages; verify off-page matches and selections, role denial, count scopes, mobile action reachability and Back behavior.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the shell, role-aware navigation and common browser acceptance fixture from 01.

tickets.title: Approve accounts and manage Relay Quota assignments
tickets.delivers: Named approval, replacement-plan and override forms with accurate effect previews, exact quota inputs and conflict recovery.
acceptance: Pending approval presents assignable plan selection, the chosen weekly allowance and Relay Session limit, an enumerated reason and a named Approve account submission.
Provide action-specific replacement-plan and quota-override forms. Submit only relevant fields and keep the applied assignment preview tied to actual plan data.
Distinguish clearing an override from an explicit zero and preserve every byte when an unchanged quantity/unit value is reopened and saved, including large or non-round allowances.
Handle no assignable plan and archived/off-page assignments correctly. Preserve immutable saved assignments; do not require the new plan-library slice to use existing seeded plans.

Keep current revision, Origin/CSRF, recent-authentication, reason, allowlist and server state validation. A stale edit reloads the affected account safely and retains list context; reauthentication does not replay the write.
Preserve safe correction inputs on validation failure and report confirmed success versus uncertainty accurately. Do not claim that changing quota resets Recorded Relay Usage.

Extend real portal approval, immutable-plan, exact-override, concurrent-policy and refusal scenarios, including count/selection refresh after mutation; verify desktop/mobile form previews, keyboard operation and no-script completion.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Requires the selected-account detail, plan read data and list-return context from 06; new plan-library maintenance is not a prerequisite.

tickets.title: Restrict relay access and complete recovery review
tickets.delivers: State-appropriate suspend, reactivate, deny, return-to-review, credential-revocation and Recovery Review Hold actions without losing the existing operator controls.
acceptance: Replace the remaining generic action selection with readable, state-appropriate account-access actions while retaining every existing supported transition and explicit recovery-review operation.

Name the target account, effect and reason before access-closing confirmations. A Recovery Review Hold remains distinct from canonical status and can only be cleared through the existing explicit status/quota review contract.

Keep account and Login Grant/Relay Session consequences exactly as enforced by the service. Successful invalidation remains logically acknowledged before success; physical closure can follow asynchronously.

Revalidate authoritative allowlist, recent authentication, reason, Origin/CSRF, current revision and server-side state eligibility for every write. Browser visibility or stale form selection is never authority.
Retain safe conflict, denied, expired-authentication and uncertain-outcome recovery through the existing operations, including a working no-script confirmation path.

Exercise real transition/revocation/recovery-hold behavior and refusal/concurrency cases through the accepted HTTP/database seam; verify that the revised controls remain reachable and explained at all three browser widths.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Requires the selected-account detail and retained existing operations from 06; quota-form redesign in 07 is not a prerequisite.

tickets.title: Maintain immutable Quota Plans in their own view
tickets.delivers: A separate bounded plan library with working plan creation, reviewed archival and safe retry of an uncertain creation.
acceptance: Provide a separate authorized Quota Plans view with names, weekly allowance, Relay Session limits, availability and bounded stable pagination; existing account-review operations remain reachable during migration.
Create plans through the real validated quantity/unit, reason and authority contract. Do not introduce in-place edits or client self-selection.
Explain archival before confirmation: no new assignments use the archived plan, and existing saved assignments remain unchanged and correctly presented.
Preserve creation operation identity/proof through ambiguous results and retry the same operation; never silently generate a new creation attempt or duplicate plan.
Handle zero/large values, invalid fields, archived states, no plans, stale revisions, fresh-authentication requirements and authority changes with safe correction/recovery.

Reuse immutable-plan and lost-commit-acknowledgment integration scenarios; verify real forms, confirmation/retry destinations, numeric alignment, keyboard/no-script paths and readable phone plan rows in the built service.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the common A presentation/navigation and browser fixture from 01; account-list redesign and approval forms are not prerequisites.

tickets.title: Authorize or cancel a registered Clipp app
tickets.delivers: Compact consent that identifies the actual app, account and relay, with real authorization and a safe one-use Cancel operation.
acceptance: Display the verified registered public-client type in the heading and action, and the authenticated verified presentation email and configured relay host from trusted view data.
Explain relay permission within the saved account allowance without implying Device Identity binding or Device Network membership changes.
Preserve the existing authorization flow and add Cancel through the native issuer error-response mechanism, returning access_denied and the original state only to its validated callback.

Cancel consumes only a valid current one-use continuation after Portal Session, Origin/CSRF, account, browser binding, generation and expiry checks. It issues no code, Login Grant or Relay Access Token.

Refuse replay, expired/mismatched/consumed flows and invalid callback destinations safely. In an authorize/cancel race only the first valid consumed operation succeeds; cancellation cannot undo an authorization that already won.
Keep PKCE, registered callback/CSP policy, continuation bounds and exact client behavior. Do not add an arbitrary query-derived redirect or weaken protection for a visual Cancel button.

Extend existing consent one-use, generation and callback-policy HTTP tests for all registered client families, plus the focused browser form, keyboard and no-script authorize/cancel flows. No live Google or native runtime is required.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the settled embedded style tokens and production browser acceptance fixture from 01; it does not wait for account administration or plan maintenance.

tickets.title: Recover failed portal requests without misleading actions
tickets.delivers: Task-sized setup and failure pages whose recovery action matches the actual failure while preserving statuses and fail-closed uncertainty.
acceptance: Apply the compact A message presentation to service setup, expired sign-in, forbidden action, missing page, conflict, rate limiting, service unavailability and uncertain account results.
A conflict reloads the affected object; an expired sign-in reauthenticates; rate limits preserve authoritative retry hints; no state offers an unrelated sign-in loop or arbitrary return URL.
Keep HTTP status, safe destinations, response headers, authority checks and access-closing uncertainty intact. Never show a success toast for an unconfirmed saved result or blindly retry a POST.

Provide usable safe read-only recovery links without JavaScript and honest task-sized sparse content. Specific plan-creation retry identity stays owned by the plan-maintenance slice; deletion lifecycle stays owned by the deletion slice.

Check these responses through the real HTTP boundary and built-service browser views at the accepted widths, including focus, readable text and no page overflow. Existing per-feature mutation/conflict tests remain required in their own slices.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Uses the settled shared presentation and authenticated application fixture from 01; it can validate existing failure operations independently of their later UI migrations.

tickets.title: Complete Workspace cutover and verify combined journeys
tickets.delivers: One coherent production portal with all selected A views connected, temporary legacy UI removed and complete owner/admin journeys proven against the built artifact.
acceptance: Finish navigation and compatibility cutover only after every replacement view and action exists; retain safe handling/redirects for established entry points. Remove temporary legacy presentation and any prototype-only controls or sample data without losing a supported capability.

Walk the combined local journeys across separate owner and administrator sessions: sign in and prepare setup, review/approve with a saved plan, authorize or cancel the app, inspect account data/history, change a plan/override, restrict/restore/review access, revoke, sign out and exercise deletion pending/completion as appropriate.

Check links, Back/filter/page context, status/count/plan agreement, real mutation results and expected authority boundaries after crossing views. Fix integration defects rather than changing or duplicating the domain contracts.

Complete keyboard, semantic naming, focus restoration, announcements, 320px reflow, enlarged-text, reduced-motion and no-script acceptance across the joined views. Each earlier slice remains responsible for its own feature-level accessibility and tests.

Capture all final built-service account/list/detail/plan/security/sign-in/consent/restricted/error/retry/deletion states at 1440×900, 768×1024 and 390×844. Require zero app-inspector FAIL findings, inspect the images and explain retained warnings by actual impact without hiding content or inventing records.

Run and record the relay routine profile, the required local PostgreSQL 17/18 integration/smoke executions and race checks applicable to changed shared state, with source revision and skipped checks explicit. Static prototype checks do not establish application acceptance.

Complete Standards and Spec review of the integrated result and record any remaining acceptance boundary. Do not publish, deploy, mutate live infrastructure, require live OAuth accounts or start native client/forced-transfer qualification.
tickets.blocking_rationale: Needs all replacement areas before compatibility cleanup and combined acceptance; transitive blockers 01, 04 and 06 are deliberately omitted.

scope: Planning/publication only; implementation not started; parent spec unchanged.

approval.user_statement: Looks good. Publish the 12 tickets with these blockers. don't start implementation
approval.scope: Publish the twelve approved local issues with unchanged blockers; do not start implementation.
